answer.summary: Two ArchUnit tenant-access rules fail deterministically, and both violations come from code this change adds. PayloadCustomizationService calls InjectorContract.getAttackPatterns() and PayloadCustomizationMerge/PayloadLocalVersioning call PayloadIdentity methods, none of which are on the rule's allowed list. Rerunning will hit the same assertions; the fix is to route these accesses through an allowed class or update the rule deliberately.
